title: Final Configuration of a Window-Bounded Run
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $x$ and $w$ be binary strings, and let $s$ be a natural number. If every configuration reached from the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ by following any prefix of $w$ lies in the window of radius $s$, then the configuration reached by following all of $w$ also lies in that window; that is, every work-tape head is at a position $z$ with $|z|\le s$, and every work-tape cell at a position $z$ with $|z|>s$ is blank.
hypotheses_covered: N is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet.
x and w are binary strings.
For every prefix length j from 0 through |w|, the configuration after the first j choice bits of w lies in the radius-s window.
